meta.description: Ka soo deji fiidiyowyo, sawirro iyo cod TikTok, Instagram, Facebook iyo boqolaal websaydh oo kale si bilaash ah.

hero.title: Ka soo deji fiidiyowyo, sawirro iyo cod bar kasta oo bulshada ah
hero.lead: Ku dheji link ka yimid TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Pinterest iyo kuwo kale. Dooro tayada, kadibna si toos ah ugu kaydi qalabkaaga.

how.title: Sida loo soo dejiyo
how.step1.title: Koobiyee link-ga
how.step1.text: Ka fur qoraalka app-ka, taabo La wadaag, kadibna dooro Koobiyee link-ga.
how.step2.title: Halkan ku dheji
how.step2.text: Ku dheji link-ga sanduuqa sare, kadibna riix Soo deji.
how.step3.title: Dooro oo kaydi
how.step3.text: Dooro fiidiyow, cod MP3 ah, ama sawir tayada aad rabto.
platforms.title: Barxadaha la taageero
platforms.lead: Fiidiyowyo, sawirro iyo cod ka yimid boqolaal websaydh. Qaar ka mid ah kuwa ugu caansan:
faq.title: Su'aalaha inta badan la is weydiiyo
faq.q1: I Need Save ma bilaash baa?
faq.a1: Haa, gebi ahaanba waa bilaash. Looma baahna is-diiwaangelin, gelitaan ama app.
faq.a2: Android iyo kombiyuutarrada, faylashu waxay galaan galka Soo dejisyada. iPhone iyo iPad (Safari), waxaa lagu kaydiyaa app-ka Faylasha → Soo dejisyada. Halkaas ayaad uga kaydin kartaa Sawirrada adigoo isticmaalaya badhanka La wadaag.
faq.q3: Maxay qaar ka mid ah fiidiyowyada u soo degi waayaan?
faq.a3: Server-keennu ma gaari karo nuxurka gaarka ah, nuxurka u baahan gelitaan, ama nuxurka gobol ahaan loo xaddiday. Hubi in qoraalku yahay mid dadweyne, kadibna isku day mar kale.
faq.a4: Marka link-ga la habeeyo kadib, dooro MP3 oo ku hoos jira Cod. Codka waxaa laga soo saaraa fiidiyowga, waxaana loo beddelaa MP3 192 kbps ah.
faq.q5: Fiidiyowyada TikTok ma leeyihiin calaamadda biyaha?
faq.a5: Had iyo jeer waxaan doorbidnaa nuqulka aan lahayn calaamadda biyaha marka uu jiro. Doorashooyinka leh calaamadda biyaha waxaa lagu calaamadeeyay Calaamadda biyaha.
faq.a6: Maya. Faylasha si toos ah ayaa looga soo diraa barxadda asalka ah ilaa qalabkaaga, laguma kaydiyo server-keenna.

articles.title: Maqaallo
articles.description: Talooyin iyo hagayaal lagu soo dejiyo fiidiyowyada, sawirrada iyo codka baraha bulshada.
results.loading: Faylasha waa la soo helayaa… tani waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr ilbiriqsi.
toast.preparing: Faylkaaga waa la diyaarinayaa… soo dejintu si toos ah ayay u bilaabanaysaa.
toast.failed: Soo dejintu way guuldareysatay. Isku day tayo kale ama mar kale habee link-ga.
toast.clipboardEmpty: Clipboard-kaagu waa madhan yahay. Marka hore koobiyee link.
toast.clipboardDenied: Gelitaanka clipboard-ka waa la diiday. Gacanta ku dheji link-ga.
error.empty: Marka hore ku dheji link qoraal ama fiidiyow.
error.timeout: Waqtigii wuu dhammaaday. Ishu way ka daahday jawaabta, fadlan isku day mar kale.
error.offline: Ma jiro xiriir internet. Hubi shabakaddaada oo isku day mar kale.
error.busy: Server-ku waa mashquul. Fadlan isku day mar kale wax yar kadib.
error.invalid_url: Link khaldan. Ku dheji link-ga oo dhammaystiran ee ka yimid app-ka baraha bulshada.
error.unsupported: Link-gan weli lama taageero. Hubi inuu si toos ah ugu tilmaamayo qoraal ama fiidiyow.
error.blocked: Barxaddan hadda waxay xannibaysaa server-keenna, sidaa darteed link-gan hadda lama soo dejin karo.
error.rate_limited: Barxaddu waxay xaddidaysaa codsiyada ka imanaya server-keenna. Fadlan isku day mar kale wax yar kadib.
error.login_required: Nuxurkani waa gaar, ama barxaddu waxay u baahan tahay gelitaan si loo arko, sidaa darteed lama soo dejin karo.
error.not_found: Nuxurka lama helin ama waa la tirtiray.
error.geo_blocked: Nuxurkan gobol ahaan waa la xaddiday, server-keennuna ma gaari karo.
error.failed: Faylal lagama heli karin link-gan. Isku day link kale ama isku day mar kale wax yar kadib.
error.no_media: Ma jiraan faylal la soo dejin karo oo ku jira link-gan.
error.server_config: Server-ka weli si sax ah looma habayn.
error.server_error: Wax baa ka khaldamay server-ka. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
